title: PEAK
notes: Experimental Windows Steam game under official Proton on WSL. Starts at the native title screen with a clean local profile; the model discovers the airport and expedition itself. Private read-only runtime instrumentation records native height, region and terminal state. Operator checks and autonomous Trials are separate. Daily island rotation and unvalidated late-game milestones limit comparisons.
introduction: PEAK is a first-person climbing survival game. A fresh attempt begins at the title screen, continues through an airport and then an island expedition. Ascending through successive regions leads toward the summit. An expedition can end in native victory or loss. The island rotates daily.
controls: WASD moves; Shift sprints or leaps while climbing; Space jumps; Control crouches; E interacts; Q drops or throws (hold); 1-3 selects item slots, 4 selects the backpack, and Tab stashes the selected item. The mouse turns the view or operates menus; left mouse climbs or uses an item, right mouse offers a helping hand or alternate item use. Escape opens the menu. When fully downed, hold the interaction key E to give up. Shared aliases: arrow keys move the mouse at 600 pixels per second; J and K hold left and right mouse respectively. Native free mouse and keyboard actions remain available to the language model.
